title: Adjacent calendar periods
brief: Compare adjacent calendar periods rather than adjacent observed periods.
instructions: Return exactly twelve 2024 months with paid transaction revenue, previous calendar-month revenue, and current minus previous. Fill absent revenue with zero. First previous and change are NULL.

A paid order is an order whose own status is 'paid'; the payments table carries a separate status that these challenges never ask about. For paid reporting activity, include timestamps at or after 2024-01-01 00:00:00 UTC and exclude timestamps at or after 2025-01-01 00:00:00 UTC.
Return only the declared output columns, in their declared order and exact SQL types. Follow the output ordering contract; NULL ordering is explicit.
starterExplanation: This starter exposes order_id,ordered_at,status from orders without solving adjacent calendar periods.

hints.text: Gap-fill the calendar before applying LAG.
Join monthly revenue onto twelve calendar months, then compare adjacent rows.
March is zero and February is its predecessor; January has no previous row.
